subject.system: repository collaborator identity and entrypoint references
subject.target_state: named collaborator entrypoints and canonical repository governance

design.why_replay: Frozen, labeled fixtures isolate classifier behavior from changing repository content. The full sweep runs against the current repository snapshot and records baseline/candidate SHAs. Identity collision checks remain a hard invariant, not an optimized treatment.
design.fixture_set: Embedded in scripts/identity/rotation_sweep.py; each fixture has a reviewed active/historical/tool-only truth label.
design.stopping_rule: Stop on unresolved ambiguous references, active legacy dependencies, missing mappings, or moniker collisions. Re-run after a bounded mapping batch; promote only after all hard gates pass on the same candidate SHA.

responses.primary: fixture classification accuracy, precision, recall, false-positive count and false-negative count by classifier arm

decision_rule.text: Select the lowest-complexity classifier ensemble that preserves zero false negatives for active path/link/workflow dependencies and records historical/tool-only references distinctly. The repository gate independently requires zero active legacy dependencies, zero unresolved ambiguous references, complete mapping targets, and zero moniker collisions.
decision_rule.promotion: No automatic identity or routing mutation. Mapping edits require a reviewed branch/PR; DoE only records evidence and proposes the best classifier configuration.

registration.note: Design precedes repository sweep execution. One workflow run emits one EXPERIMENT record bound to base and candidate SHA.
